subject.title: [Feature]: Channel Broker Phase 2A - broker conformance harness

question: Should OpenClaw approve a new Channel Broker SDK/bundled plugin boundary for conformance work, or should this reliability work extend the current `channel-outbound` message-adapter contracts instead?
rationale: The requested harness depends on a public plugin SDK, bundled channel, message-delivery, config, and security boundary that current main does not contain and that the linked broad stack was not approved to land.

options.title: Require Smaller Design First
options.body: Keep this issue open as the narrow tracker, but require a maintainer-approved design/API boundary before any broker conformance code starts.

options.title: Use Current Channel Contracts
options.body: Redirect the work toward extending `channel-outbound` and message-adapter proof helpers instead of introducing a separate broker layer.

options.title: Approve Broker Direction
options.body: Accept a new broker SDK/plugin boundary and then scope one focused PR to the conformance harness only.

recommendation.title: Require Smaller Design First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the narrow tracker, but require a maintainer-approved design/API boundary before any broker conformance code starts.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle made the live close decision on the linked Channel Broker stack and has recent plugin SDK boundary history.
